references.text: The account of Amalek's attack on Israel at Rephidim, where they struck the rear guard—the weak and exhausted Israelites
Balaam's prophecy about Amalek as the first among the nations, but who will ultimately perish
God remembers what Amalek did to Israel when they came up out of Egypt, and commands Saul to completely destroy them
The Lord's promise to utterly blot out the memory of Amalek under heaven
The preceding verse that commands Israel to remember what Amalek did
The following verse that commands Israel to blot out the memory of Amalek
Amalek is mentioned among Israel's enemies who have conspired together against God's people
